content.text:
Does this text message actually offer that CO will call THEM — Cue proposing to place an outbound call to the person, not just telling them how they can call Cue themselves — in any wording, even indirectly (e.g. "I'm here if you want to talk this through")? Not just related to talking or listening in general — specifically Cue offering to call them.

Message: "That's great, Hayes Valley confirmed is a real win.

Lock the headcount next, even a rough one, since the venue will want it to plan tables and food.

Then get invites out this week. A month out is good timing, people can actually plan around it.

After that, nail down the menu or catering options with them, and whether they handle wine or you're bringing your own.

Last thing, confirm what time you actually need the room (setup vs when guests arrive) so there's no scramble on the 14th."

Return ONLY "yes" or "no".
